1.

The petitioner is apprehending her arrest for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 341,
406, 420, 120B, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code in connection with Gomia P.S. Case no.30 of 2024, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Bermo at Tenughat.
2.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Bermo at Tenughat
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that it is a case under Sections 323,
341, 406, 420, 120B, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, maximum sentence for which is up to 07 years, as well as keeping in view the guidelines laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and Anr., reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273, particularly paragraph no.12 of the same, followed by the judgment rendered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr., reported in 2022 (10)
SCC 51, as well as the observation made in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr., reported in 2024 (9) SCC 198, without commenting on the merit of the present case, the petitioner is directed to appear and seek regular bail before the concerned Trial Court Laxmi Devi vs The State Of Jharkhand .......... Opp. ... on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103913412/
1 within three weeks, which shall be disposed of by the said Court in strict compliance of the guidelines laid down in the aforesaid cases.
